claim: In the HWA laboratory, composer job streams using STARTCOND FILECREATED and FILEMODIFIED generated internal filemonitor jobs (filemonitorlauncher -event fileCreated -scanInterval N). The FILEMODIFIED variant triggered the dependent job, while the FILECREATED variant failed with AWSITA030E because the ${agent-config:bin-path} in the generated JSDL did not resolve to the actual filemonitorlauncher path (/opt/hwa/TWS/bin/filemonitorlauncher).
source_url: local composer validate/add and conman sj;std; generated JSDL
supporting_quote: Generated jsdle:script references ${agent-config:bin-path}filemonitorlauncher which did not resolve.
notes: The filemonitor bin-path configuration must be validated; FILECREATED variant requires the file to not pre-exist. STARTCOND JOB syntax is supported.
